gbm_population_evidence.quote: Tumor Hypoxia and Proliferation in Patients With High-Grade Glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: FMISO PET (Fluoromisonidazole-PET) allows researchers to study whether tumor cells lack oxygen (hypoxia).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Thirty newly diagnosed treatment-naïve subjects with suspected HGG based on clinical presentation and MRI findings

role_evidence.quote: Suspected HGG subjects will undergo combined FMISO/FLT dyn-PET at baseline as part of surgical planning.
